capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Audi: gross storage capacity 100 kWh (12 modules). US A6/Q6 are all 100 kWh (electrive 2027 table; Electrek: RWD Q6 has the 100 kWh pack, not the 83 kWh pack sold elsewhere).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Audi: 94.9 kWh net. Cars.com (US) agrees. Wards/Car and Driver give 94.4 for the US A6.

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia (A6 e-tron): 100 kWh pack is twelve modules of prismatic NMC811 cells (CATL); the Q6 page lists "100 kWh 12-Modules NMC CATL".

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Audi's PPE release credits "the new preconditioned HV battery, and the new predictive thermal management"; it does not say how it is triggered (Audi route-planner documentation not opened). Recorded as navigation-triggered; no manual control is described.

dc_max_kw.notes: Electrek: US RWD Q6 e-tron DC tops out at 260 kW (270 kW for the lineup).

ac_max_kw.notes: Cars.com (US 2025 Q6): 9.6 kW onboard charger; Audi Europe 11 kW. Canada not separately sourced.

published_10_80_min.notes: Audi: 10-80 % in about 21 minutes (best case, 800 V DC charger).
